walk.en: I have no feet, I drift along.

walk.zh: 风一吹，我就散开又聚起。
walk.en: When the wind blows, I scatter and gather again.

walk.zh: 你听见笑声，却看不见我。
walk.en: You hear laughter but cannot see me.
I slide along just above the grass tips.
A purple haze, shifting slowly forward.

walk.zh: 我走过的地方，草会打卷。
walk.en: Where I pass, the grass curls up.
Stop searching, I am on your shoulder.

walk.zh: 空气变甜了，那是我到了。
walk.en: The air turned sweet, that means I have arrived.

walk.zh: 我飘得很慢，是想让你跟上。
walk.en: I drift slowly so you can keep up.

walk.zh: 影子底下最舒服，我走那边。
walk.en: Under the shadows is best, I go that way.

walk.zh: 我一边飘，一边把气息吐出去。
walk.en: I drift while breathing my haze outward.

walk.zh: 这片草地太小，装不下我的笑声。
walk.en: This meadow is too small for my laughter.

idle.zh: 我把脸凑近，你才看得见轮廓。
idle.en: I bring my face close so you see my outline.

idle.zh: 甜味是我的，别到处乱闻。
idle.en: The sweetness is mine, do not sniff around.

idle.zh: 我数着草叶，数到第十片就忘了。
idle.en: I count grass blades, forgetting at the tenth.

idle.zh: 三十点体力，够我玩一整天。
idle.en: Thirty hit points are enough to play all day.

idle.zh: 幽灵不需要睡觉，只需要发呆。
idle.en: Ghosts do not sleep, we just stare into nothing.

idle.zh: 我吐出一口紫雾，又吸回去。
idle.en: I breathe out purple mist, then pull it back.

idle.zh: 你打不到我，我本来就没实体。
idle.en: You cannot hit me, I have no real body.

idle.zh: 附近有人怕我，我闻得出来。
idle.en: Someone nearby fears me, I can smell it.

idle.zh: 我笑一声，草丛里就静了。
idle.en: I laugh once, and the grass falls silent.

idle.zh: 这团气是我全部的家当。
idle.en: This cloud of gas is all I own.

idle.zh: 我在等天黑，白天太亮了。
idle.en: I am waiting for nightfall, the day is too bright.

idle.zh: 甜香散得太快，我得再酿一点。
idle.en: The sweetness fades quickly, I must brew more.

idle.zh: 别用灯照我，我会缩成一团。
idle.en: Do not shine a lamp at me, I curl into a ball.

idle.zh: 我叫鬼斯，记不住也没关系。
idle.en: My name is Gastly, it is fine if you forget.

look_player.en: You are looking at me? I am looking too.

look_player.zh: 别眨眼，我一眨眼就换位置。
look_player.en: Do not blink, one blink and I move.
Put down that lantern in your hand first.

look_player.zh: 我这张脸，是不是很像笑脸？
look_player.en: Does my face look like a smiling one?

look_player.zh: 你身上有股铁锈味，练武的？
look_player.en: You smell of rust, are you a fighter?

look_player.zh: 靠近点，我想看清你的眼睛。
look_player.en: Come closer, I want to see your eyes clearly.

look_player.zh: 你怕我，可我没打算害你。
look_player.en: You fear me, but I mean you no harm.

look_player.zh: 我绕着你转了一圈，你都没发现。
look_player.en: I circled you once and you never noticed.

look_player.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我听见了。
look_player.en: Your breathing changed, I heard it.

look_player.zh: 别拿精灵球指着我，那东西讨厌。
look_player.en: Do not point a Poké Ball at me, I hate that thing.

look_player.zh: 你身后那位，也是来抓我的？
look_player.en: Is that one behind you here to catch me too?

look_player.zh: 我只有三十点血，可你抓不住我。
look_player.en: I have only thirty HP, yet you cannot catch me.

look_player.zh: 你的影子真好看，借我待一会儿。
look_player.en: Your shadow is lovely, let me rest in it a while.

look_player.zh: 我在你耳边说话，你别转头。
look_player.en: I speak at your ear, do not turn your head.

tempted.zh: 那股甜味，是从你口袋出来的？
tempted.en: That sweetness, is it coming from your pocket?
Let me have one sniff, just one.

tempted.zh: 我不吃粮食，我吃空气里的甜。
tempted.en: I do not eat grain, I eat sweetness in the air.

tempted.zh: 你带的果子烂了，正合我意。
tempted.en: The fruit you carry is rotting, just as I like.
This smell pulls at me so I cannot move on.
Do not put it away, I have not had enough.

tempted.zh: 我跟着你，是跟着那股香味。
tempted.en: I follow you for the sake of that fragrance.

tempted.zh: 一点点就好，我胃口很小。
tempted.en: Just a little, my appetite is tiny.

tempted.zh: 甜的东西放久了，才最香。
tempted.en: Sweet things smell best after sitting a while.

tempted.zh: 你手心那点糖，别浪费了。
tempted.en: That bit of sugar in your palm, do not waste it.

collide.zh: 你穿过去了，像穿过一阵雾。
collide.en: You passed through me like walking through mist.

collide.zh: 撞我有什么意义？我没有身体。
collide.en: What is the point of hitting me? I have no body.
You shivered just now, did you not?
I brushed past your face, cold, right?
I scatter from the bump, then gather again.

collide.zh: 别推我，我会钻进你衣领。
collide.en: Do not push me, I will slip into your collar.

collide.zh: 这一下撞得我晃了晃，仅此而已。
collide.en: That bump made me sway, nothing more.

collide.zh: 我轻得像一口气，你怎么撞得实？
collide.en: I am light as breath, how can you hit me solidly?

collide.zh: 你退了三步，我只飘了一寸。
collide.en: You stepped back three paces, I drifted one inch.

collide.zh: 下次绕开我，我不想沾上人味。
collide.en: Walk around me next time, I dislike the smell of people.

mate.en: Gastly find each other by sweetness.

mate.zh: 两团紫雾缠在一起，就是相认。
mate.en: Two purple mists entwine, that is how we greet.

mate.zh: 我酿了最甜的一口气，给你。
mate.en: I brewed my sweetest breath for you.

mate.zh: 别怕，我们不会真的碰在一起。
mate.en: Do not fear, we will never truly touch.

mate.zh: 幽灵也有想留下什么的时候。
mate.en: Even ghosts sometimes want to leave something behind.

mate.zh: 我们的蛋，会藏在最暗的草里。
mate.en: Our egg will hide in the darkest grass.

mate.zh: 你再靠近一点，雾就交叠了。
mate.en: Come a little closer, and our mists overlap.

mate.zh: 这片草地够大，够我们飘。
mate.en: This meadow is big enough for us to drift in.

mate.zh: 我会记住你这口气的味道。
mate.en: I will remember the taste of your breath.
Do not be shy, ghosts understand tenderness too.

pickup.zh: 这枚果子我拿走了，反正你掉了。
pickup.en: I am taking this berry, you dropped it anyway.

pickup.zh: 用雾气卷起来，省得沾手。
pickup.en: I lift it with mist so my hands stay clean.

pickup.zh: 捡东西？我没有手，只能吸过来。
pickup.en: Pick things up? I have no hands, I just draw it in.
Whose copper coin is this, let me sniff it first.

pickup.zh: 这堆腐叶底下，藏着好东西。
pickup.en: Something good hides under this pile of rotting leaves.

pickup.zh: 我把它含在雾里，谁也找不着。
pickup.en: I hold it inside my mist, no one can find it.

pickup.zh: 捡起来的东西，最后都烂在我胃里。
pickup.en: Whatever I pick up rots inside me eventually.

pickup.zh: 这枚小石头，暖的，真奇怪。
pickup.en: This little stone is warm, how strange.

pickup.zh: 你掉了什么？我帮你吸过来。
pickup.en: Did you drop something? I will draw it over for you.

pickup.zh: 我收着这枚扣子，亮闪闪的。
pickup.en: I am keeping this button, it glitters nicely.

target_acquire.zh: 你的心跳，我听得一清二楚。
target_acquire.en: I hear your heartbeat perfectly clearly.
Do not run, the sweetness follows you.

target_acquire.zh: 我盯上你了，从你踏进草地开始。
target_acquire.en: I marked you the moment you entered the grass.

target_acquire.zh: 幽灵出手，从来不打招呼。

target_acquire.en: Your shadow belongs to me now.
I smell fear, how sweet it is.
That lantern, I will put it out first.
You stepped on the grass hiding my egg.

target_acquire.zh: 目标就在三步之外，飘过去就够。
target_acquire.en: The target is three paces away, one drift is enough.

target_acquire.zh: 别以为看不见，就打不到你。
target_acquire.en: Do not think being unseen means I cannot hit you.

targeting.zh: 我绕到你左边，你没发现。
targeting.en: I slip to your left, and you never notice.

targeting.zh: 雾慢慢收拢，围成一个圈。
targeting.en: The mist slowly closes into a ring.

targeting.zh: 再退一步，你就进草丛了。
targeting.en: One more step back and you are in the grass.

targeting.zh: 我贴着他的后背，凉意先到。
targeting.en: I press to his back, the chill arrives first.
His armor cannot stop poison gas.
I lower my voice and laugh once.
When he turns around, I scatter.

targeting.zh: 距离刚好，一口雾能罩住他。
targeting.en: Just the right distance, one breath of mist covers him.

targeting.zh: 他的灯灭了，现在该我了。
targeting.en: His lamp is out, now it is my turn.

targeting.zh: 我数到三，就从草里出来。
targeting.en: I count to three, then come out of the grass.

melee_attack.zh: 我没拳头，只有一团毒雾。
melee_attack.en: I have no fist, only a cloud of poison mist.

melee_attack.zh: 碰到我的人，都会抖一下。
melee_attack.en: Anyone who touches me shivers once.

melee_attack.zh: 这一口吸下去，你头会晕。
melee_attack.en: One breath of this and your head will swim.

melee_attack.zh: 我撞进他胸口，寒气透骨。
melee_attack.en: I lunge into his chest, the chill sinks to the bone.
A ghost's claw is the unseen kind.
One lick and he will be numb for hours.
I leave no wound, only cold.

melee_attack.zh: 这一下不重，可会一直疼。
melee_attack.en: This blow is light, but it aches on and on.

melee_attack.zh: 他挥空了，我已经在背后。
melee_attack.en: He swung at air, I am already behind him.
After the strike I withdraw, never lingering.

spawn.zh: 草丛里先起了一阵甜风。
spawn.en: A sweet wind rises from the grass first.

spawn.zh: 我慢慢凝出形状，脸先出现。
spawn.en: I slowly take shape, my face appearing first.

spawn.zh: 八级的小鬼斯，也够吓人一跳。
spawn.en: Even a level eight Gastly can make you jump.
This meadow is mine to play in now.

spawn.zh: 天还没黑，我就先出来了。
spawn.en: The sky is not dark yet, and I am already out.

spawn.zh: 有人在这儿点灯，太亮了。
spawn.en: Someone lit a lamp here, it is too bright.

spawn.zh: 我从腐叶堆里钻出来，带着酸味。
spawn.en: I rise from the rotting leaves with a sour tang.

spawn.zh: 一出现，附近的虫就不叫了。
spawn.en: The moment I appear, the nearby bugs go quiet.

spawn.zh: 别怕，我只是来看看新面孔。
spawn.en: Do not worry, I only came to see a new face.

spawn.zh: 二十五级的老鬼斯，见得多。
spawn.en: A level twenty-five Gastly has seen plenty.
My sweetness arrives before I do.

spawn.zh: 这地方的空气，我闻着舒服。
spawn.en: The air here feels pleasant to me.

generic.en: A corner of my mist was blown apart.

generic.zh: 三十点血，掉一点都心疼。
generic.en: Thirty hit points, every one lost stings.
I shrank for a moment, then swelled back.

generic.zh: 这一拳穿过去，只带走一片紫。
generic.en: That punch passed through, taking only some purple.

generic.zh: 我的甜味淡了，得补回来。
generic.en: My sweetness thinned, I must restore it.
Do not gloat, I have not dispersed yet.
I wobbled twice and steadied myself.

fall.zh: 我从半空掉下来，摔成一团。
fall.en: I dropped from the air and splattered.

drown.zh: 水把我压住，我浮不上来。
drown.en: Water presses me down and I cannot rise.

explosion.zh: 炸开的气浪，把我撕成两半。
explosion.en: The blast tore me into two halves.

projectile.zh: 箭穿过去，在我身上留个洞。
projectile.en: The arrow passed through, leaving a hole.

magic.en: The spell binds me and I cannot break free.

starvation.zh: 三天没闻到甜味，我快散了。
starvation.en: Three days without sweetness and I am fading.

lightning.zh: 雷光一亮，我整团都透了。
lightning.en: The lightning flash made my whole body transparent.

void.zh: 虚空里没有风，我飘不起来。
void.en: In the void there is no wind to drift on.
